ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with a high-frequency distribution of high-intensity (white) micro-clusters; macro-ratio estimated at 85:15 dark-to-light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of small, circular white pixel clusters (stippling) across both lobes, with more contiguous high-intensity patches localized at the lateral tips and along the upper trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the boundary; the right lobe exhibits high-amplitude, sawtooth-like triangular peaks, while the left lobe features lower-amplitude, jagged variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curves tapering into elongated, posteriorly-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white pixel clusters distributed across the mid-surface and concentrated near the right lateral tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular notch on the inner half of the left lobe trailing edge and distinctive ragged edge erosion at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'starfield' mottling pattern is highly distinct, characterized by a uniform density of micro-speckles across the entire visible ventral surface.
